{{Top|leg}}
'''Flexicris''' was a material developed during final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Used in lightweight facial shrouds for extravehicular activity, flexicris shrouds were often paired with specialized [[thinskin]] emergency [[Environment suit/Legends|vac suits]] for use aboard starships in case of a hull breach.
